idea-plugin.name: SimpleDomControl
idea-plugin.description: Tool window support for SimpleDomControl (SDC) projects. Shows all SDC models (python model, forms, list/detail/form templates) and all SDC controllers (tag name, URL, python view, JS/SCSS/HTML files) grouped by Django app. Running the entries opens the file in the editor at the class definition line. On every refresh the controller tags and the sdc_<event> attributes are added to the custom tags/attributes of the HTML inspections, so they are no longer reported as unknown. The information is gathered by the Django management commands sdc_get_controller_infos and sdc_get_model_infos.
